hp_descriptions.Aberforth Dumbledore: A tall, thin, and grumpy old man with stringy grey hair and a beard, looking remarkably like his older brother but much rougher around the edges.
hp_descriptions.Alastor Moody: Characterized by his heavily scarred, carved-up face, a missing chunk of his nose, grizzled dark grey hair, and a vivid, whizzing, electric-blue magical eye.
hp_descriptions.Albus Percival Wulfric Brian Dumbledore: Tall, thin, and very old, with silver hair and a beard long enough to tuck into his belt, half-moon spectacles, a crooked nose, and bright, piercing blue eyes.
hp_descriptions.Alecto Carrow: A stocky, squat witch with a coarse, heavy face and a cruel demeanor.
hp_descriptions.Alice Longbottom: Once a warm, round-faced Auror, she is later seen looking thin, worn, and deeply hollowed by years of magical trauma.
hp_descriptions.Amos Diggory: A ruddy-faced wizard with a bushy brown beard, constantly beaming with overwhelming pride for his son.
hp_descriptions.Amycus Carrow: A lumpy, pallid, and slouching wizard with a malicious laugh and an uneven, asymmetrical face.
hp_descriptions.Andromeda Tonks: Strikingly similar in appearance to her sister Bellatrix, with dark hair and heavy-lidded eyes, but with a kinder, softer expression and light brown hair.
hp_descriptions.Angelina Johnson: A tall, athletic, and fiercely competitive Black witch with long braided hair.
hp_descriptions.Arabella Doreen Figg: A batty, eccentric older woman with grizzled hair, wearing carpet slippers and constantly smelling of cabbage and her many cats.
hp_descriptions.Argus Filch: A stooped, rheumy-eyed caretaker with pasty skin, bulging pale eyes, and thin, wispy grey hair.
hp_descriptions.Ariana Dumbledore: A delicate, tragic figure, often seen in a portrait as a sweet, blonde-haired young girl with a gentle but distant expression.
hp_descriptions.Arthur Weasley: A thin, balding wizard with the trademark Weasley red hair, wearing horn-rimmed glasses and possessing an eager, curious disposition.
hp_descriptions.Aurora Sinistra: A tall witch with dark hair, often seen wearing dark robes and an astronomical hat, moving with a quiet, mysterious elegance.
hp_descriptions.Bartemius Crouch Junior: A pale, slightly unhinged-looking man with straw-colored hair, freckles, and a distinctive habit of flickering his tongue like a snake.
hp_descriptions.Bartemius Crouch Senior: Stiff, upright, and perfectly groomed, with a short toothbrush mustache and a crisp, meticulously parted hairline.
hp_descriptions.Bathilda Bagshot: An incredibly old, frail witch with a stooped back, thin white hair, and heavily spotted, translucent skin.
hp_descriptions.Bellatrix Lestrange: Once possessing aristocratic beauty, she is described as having heavy-lidded eyes, dark, thick, shining hair, and a pallid, gaunt face worn down by years in Azkaban.
hp_descriptions.Blaise Zabini: A tall, strikingly handsome Black wizard with high cheekbones and a deeply arrogant, dismissive expression.
hp_descriptions.Cedric Diggory: An exceptionally handsome, tall, and solidly built young wizard with grey eyes, straight dark hair, and an honorable, modest demeanor.
hp_descriptions.Charlie Weasley: Shorter and stockier than his brothers, heavily freckled and weather-beaten, with muscular arms bearing shiny burn scars from dragons.
hp_descriptions.Cho Chang: A very pretty, popular Ravenclaw student with long, shiny dark hair and a polite, sweet disposition.
hp_descriptions.Colin Creevey: A tiny, mousy-haired boy with an ever-present camera, practically vibrating with enthusiastic, nervous energy.
hp_descriptions.Corban Yaxley: A brutal-looking wizard with a heavy, harsh face, a scarred forehead, and an intimidating, thuggish build.
hp_descriptions.Cormac McLaggen: A large, broad-shouldered, and wiry young man with a highly confident and deeply arrogant smirk.
hp_descriptions.Cornelius Oswald Fudge: A portly, fussy man frequently wearing a pinstriped cloak, a lime-green bowler hat, and an anxious, flustered expression.
hp_descriptions.Dean Thomas: A tall, artistic Black boy from London with an easygoing attitude and a persistent loyalty to his friends.
hp_descriptions.Dedalus Diggle: A tiny, excitable wizard in a violet top hat who constantly bounces with nervous enthusiasm.
hp_descriptions.Dennis Creevey: Even smaller and more frantic than his brother Colin, with mousy hair and a similarly oversized sense of awe.
hp_descriptions.Dobby: A small house-elf with large, bat-like ears, bulging green eyes the size of tennis balls, and a pencil-like nose.
hp_descriptions.Dolores Jane Umbridge: Resembling a large, pale toad, she has a broad, flabby face, a wide, slack mouth, bulging pouchy eyes, and wears overly youthful pink bows.
hp_descriptions.Draco Lucius Malfoy: A pale, pointed-faced boy with sleek, white-blond hair, cold grey eyes, and a trademark sneer.
hp_descriptions.Dudley Dursley: A massive, pink-faced boy with watery blue eyes, thick blonde hair, and a build resembling a pig in a wig.
hp_descriptions.Ernie Macmillan: A stout, pompous boy with a loud, confident voice and a slightly self-important manner.
hp_descriptions.Fenrir Greyback: A large, feral man with matted grey hair and whiskers, pointed teeth, dirt-caked yellow nails, and a powerful scent of blood and sweat.
hp_descriptions.Filius Flitwick: An incredibly tiny, squeaky-voiced wizard with a shock of white hair, who must stand on a pile of books to see over his desk.
hp_descriptions.Firenze: A stunning centaur with a white-blond mane, a palomino body, and startlingly blue eyes that look deeply observant.
hp_descriptions.Fleur Isabelle Delacour: Possessing breathtaking, otherworldly Veela beauty, with long, rippling silvery-blonde hair, deep blue eyes, and an effortless, glowing aura.
hp_descriptions.Florean Fortescue: A cheerful, welcoming man who runs the ice cream parlor, always ready with historical facts and free sundaes.
hp_descriptions.Frank Longbottom: Similar to his wife, seen in memories as a brave Auror but later physically reduced, pale, and institutionalized by tragedy.
hp_descriptions.Fred Weasley: A tall, thin, red-haired boy, physically identical to his twin, characterized by his constant, mischievous grin.
hp_descriptions.Garrick Ollivander: An ancient, frail man with pale, silvery, moon-like eyes that shine brightly in the gloom of his dusty shop.
hp_descriptions.Gellert Grindelwald: In his youth, a strikingly handsome, golden-haired young man with a wild, merry face; in old age, a frail, skull-like figure with sunken eyes and few teeth.
hp_descriptions.George Weasley: Tall, thin, and red-haired like Fred, sharing the same freckles and rebellious smile, later missing one ear.
hp_descriptions.Gilderoy Lockhart: A dashing, conventionally handsome wizard with wavy blonde hair, dazzlingly straight white teeth, and elaborate, colorful robes.
hp_descriptions.Ginevra Molly Weasley: A vibrant girl with bright, flaming red hair worn as a long mane, a freckled face, and a fiercely determined, hard jaw.
hp_descriptions.Godric Gryffindor: Historically depicted as a tall, muscular, and bold man with a roaring, fiery red mane and beard.
hp_descriptions.Gregory Goyle: A large, hulking, gorilla-like boy with short, bristly hair, long arms, and a slow, dim-witted expression.
hp_descriptions.Hannah Abbott: A pink-faced, blonde girl who wears her hair in pigtails and is easily flustered.
hp_descriptions.Harry James Potter: A small, skinny boy with untidy jet-black hair that sticks up in the back, bright green eyes, round glasses, and a distinctive lightning-bolt scar on his forehead.
hp_descriptions.Helena Ravenclaw: The Grey Lady is tall, haughty, and elegantly beautiful, though her ghostly form carries an air of deep melancholy and hidden anger.
hp_descriptions.Helga Hufflepuff: Historically shown as a plump, welcoming, and warm witch with a cheerful, maternal demeanor.
hp_descriptions.Hepzibah Smith: An immensely fat, heavily made-up old witch wearing an elaborate ginger wig, adorned with extravagant jewelry and pink robes.
hp_descriptions.Hermione Jean Granger: A girl with a bossy voice, lots of bushy brown hair, and rather large front teeth (which are later magically shrunk).
hp_descriptions.Horace Eugene Flaccus Slughorn: A vastly plump, bald old man with an enormous belly, a silvery walrus mustache, and a penchant for fine silk smoking jackets.
hp_descriptions.Igor Karkaroff: A tall, thin man with sleek dark hair, a weak chin completely hidden by a neat goatee, and cold, calculating eyes.
hp_descriptions.Irma Pince: The librarian is a thin, severe, vulture-like woman who fiercely guards her books.
hp_descriptions.James Potter: Tall and thin, with untidy black hair identical to Harry's, hazel eyes, and an air of confident, casual arrogance.
hp_descriptions.Justin Finch-Fletchley: A curly-haired, enthusiastic Muggle-born boy with a slightly posh, upbeat attitude.
hp_descriptions.Katie Bell: A friendly, athletic Gryffindor Chaser with an earnest and brave demeanor.
hp_descriptions.Kingsley Shacklebolt: A tall, broad-shouldered Black wizard with a deep, slow voice, wearing a golden hoop earring and exuding a calm, commanding presence.
hp_descriptions.Kreacher: An ancient, foul-mouthed house-elf with skin like a plucked turkey, a snout-like nose, and bloodshot eyes.
hp_descriptions.Lavender Brown: A giggly, dramatic girl with an affinity for astrology and bright, fashionable clothes.
hp_descriptions.Lee Jordan: A boy with dreadlocks and a loud, boisterous voice, serving as the highly biased Quidditch commentator.
hp_descriptions.Leta Lestrange: A striking, dark-haired witch with a complex, shadowed expression, carrying an aura of both aristocratic pride and deep guilt.
hp_descriptions.Lily J. Potter: A beautiful woman with thick, dark red hair that falls to her shoulders, and striking, brilliant green eyes exactly like Harry's.
hp_descriptions.Lord Voldemort: A terrifying, skeletal figure with pallid, chalk-white skin, flat slits for a nose like a snake, and wide, vivid scarlet eyes with cat-like pupils.
hp_descriptions.Lucius Malfoy: A pale, cold-eyed aristocrat with long, sleek white-blond hair, often carrying a silver-handled walking stick.
hp_descriptions.Ludovic Bagman: A formerly handsome, heavily built man who has gone to seed, wearing tight, brightly colored Quidditch robes over a protruding belly, with a squashed-looking nose.
hp_descriptions.Luna Lovegood: A girl with straggly, waist-length dirty-blonde hair, pale eyebrows, and a permanent look of dreamy, unblinking surprise.
hp_descriptions.Madam Hooch: A woman with short, spiky grey hair and striking yellow eyes that resemble those of a hawk.
hp_descriptions.Madame Rosmerta: A highly attractive, curvy woman with a cheerful disposition, often seen wearing high heels and serving drinks at the Three Broomsticks.
hp_descriptions.Marietta Edgecombe: A curly-haired, nervous-looking girl whose face is famously scarred with the word "SNEAK" in purple pustules.
hp_descriptions.Marvolo Gaunt: A squat, broad-shouldered, odd-looking old man with bright brown eyes, short coarse hair, and an aggressive, ape-like posture.
hp_descriptions.Minerva McGonagall: A tall, severe-looking witch with black hair pulled into a tight bun, square glasses, and an intolerance for nonsense.
hp_descriptions.Molly Weasley: A plump, kind-faced woman with red hair, who is incredibly warm and maternal but can become fiercely intimidating when angry.
hp_descriptions.Mundungus Fletcher: A squat, unshaven man with short, bandy legs, long straggly ginger hair, and bloodshot, baggy eyes, constantly smelling of stale tobacco and alcohol.
hp_descriptions.Myrtle Elizabeth Warren: A squat, ghostly girl with thick pearlescent glasses, lank hair, and a perpetually miserable, sulky expression.
hp_descriptions.Nagini: A massive, thick-bodied green snake with a diamond pattern, stretching at least twelve feet long.
hp_descriptions.Narcissa Malfoy: A tall, slim blonde woman who is very beautiful but constantly wears a look suggesting there is a bad smell under her nose.
hp_descriptions.Neville Longbottom: A round-faced, anxious, and clumsy boy who slowly grows into a tall, formidable, and brave young man.
hp_descriptions.Newton Scamander: A tall, thin, and slightly awkward wizard with messy reddish-brown hair and an introverted, gentle manner, always wearing his blue coat.
hp_descriptions.Nicolas Flamel: An incredibly ancient alchemist, mentioned as the creator of the Philosopher's Stone, historically elusive and extremely old.
hp_descriptions.Nymphadora Tonks: A Metamorphmagus most frequently seen with a pale, heart-shaped face, dark twinkling eyes, and short, spiky, violently pink hair.
hp_descriptions.Oliver Wood: A burly, intense older boy with a fanatical, single-minded devotion to Quidditch tactics.
hp_descriptions.Olympe Maxime: A remarkably tall, elegant, olive-skinned woman with large black eyes, a beak-like nose, and dark hair pulled back in a chignon, wrapped in black satin.
hp_descriptions.Padma Patil: A very pretty girl of Indian descent with long dark hair, mirroring her identical twin sister.
hp_descriptions.Pansy Parkinson: A hard-faced, pug-nosed Slytherin girl who is frequently seen clinging to Draco Malfoy.
hp_descriptions.Parvati Patil: Identical to Padma, known for being pretty, wearing a long dark braid, and sharing a giggly affinity for Divination.
hp_descriptions.Peeves: A small, bellicose poltergeist wearing a loud, colorful suit, a bow tie, and an orange hat, with wicked black eyes and a wide, malicious grin.
hp_descriptions.Percy Ignatius Weasley: A tall, horn-rimmed-glasses-wearing redhead who carries himself with intense stiffness, pompous posture, and absolute adherence to the rules.
hp_descriptions.Peter Pettigrew: A short, balding, slightly grubby man with watery eyes, a pointed nose, and a general resemblance to a rat.
hp_descriptions.Petunia Dursley: A thin, blonde, horse-faced woman with a neck twice as long as normal, perfect for spying over garden fences.
hp_descriptions.Phineas Nigellus Black: A wizard with dark, pointed features, a neat goatee, and a permanent sneer, dressed in traditional Slytherin green and silver.
hp_descriptions.Pomona Sprout: A squat, cheerful witch with flyaway grey hair, usually wearing a patched hat and robes covered in earth from the greenhouses.
hp_descriptions.Poppy Pomfrey: The stern, bustling school matron who brooks no argument, demanding absolute rest for her patients.
hp_descriptions.Porpentina Esther Goldstein: A practical, grounded American witch with dark hair, sharp features, and an authoritative but compassionate posture.
hp_descriptions.Professor Binns: An ancient, pearlescent, shriveled ghost of an old man who drones on endlessly without noticing his students.
hp_descriptions.Quirinus Quirrell: A pale, nervous, and jittery young man who stutters constantly and wears a large, purple turban that smells faintly of garlic.
hp_descriptions.Regulus Black: Smaller, slighter, and less handsome than his older brother Sirius, with the classic dark, haughty features of the Black family.
hp_descriptions.Remus John Lupin: A pale, exhausted-looking man with premature grey streaks in his light brown hair, wearing highly shabby, patched robes.
hp_descriptions.Rita Skeeter: A woman with heavily jeweled spectacles, stiffly set blonde curls, a heavily jawed face, and long fingernails painted crimson.
hp_descriptions.Ronald Bilius Weasley: A tall, gangling boy with bright red hair, a heavy dusting of freckles, large hands and feet, and a long nose.
hp_descriptions.Rowena Ravenclaw: Historically depicted as a tall, striking, and deeply intellectual witch, beautiful but intimidating.
hp_descriptions.Rubeus Hagrid: Almost twice as tall as a normal man and at least five times as wide, resembling a wild tangle of bushy black hair and beard, with eyes like crinkled black beetles.
hp_descriptions.Rufus Scrimgeour: An aging wizard who looks like an old lion, with a mane of greying tawny hair, bushy eyebrows, yellowish eyes, and a slight limp.
hp_descriptions.Salazar Slytherin: Described from his statue as an ancient, monkey-like man with a long, thin beard that falls almost to the hem of his robes.
hp_descriptions.Seamus Finnigan: A sandy-haired Irish boy with a loud, boisterous nature and a tendency to accidentally set things on fire.
hp_descriptions.Severus Snape: A thin man with sallow skin, a large, hooked nose, uneven yellow teeth, and greasy, shoulder-length black hair that frames his cold black eyes.
hp_descriptions.Sir Nicholas de Mimsy-Porpington: A ghost dressed in an elaborate doublet and ruff, whose head is attached to his neck by only a meager hinge of skin.
hp_descriptions.Sirius Black: Initially appearing gaunt, skull-like, and feral with matted hair; he later regains some of his casual, aristocratic dark-haired good looks, though always retaining a bark-like laugh.
hp_descriptions.Stanley Shunpike: A pimply, large-eared teenager in a purple uniform who speaks with a heavy Cockney accent.
hp_descriptions.Sybill Patricia Trelawney: A remarkably thin woman enveloped in glittering shawls, looking like a large, glittering insect with enormous spectacles that magnify her eyes.
hp_descriptions.Theodore Nott: A stringy, weedy, "rabbity" looking Slytherin boy who is solitary and quiet but shares his house's prejudices.
hp_descriptions.Vernon Dursley: A large, beefy, heavily-built man with almost no neck and an enormous, bristly mustache, prone to turning purple when angry.
hp_descriptions.Viktor Krum: A thin, dark, sallow-skinned Seeker with a prominent curved nose and thick black eyebrows, who moves clumsily on the ground but like a bird in the air.
hp_descriptions.Vincent Crabbe: A very thickset, toweringly large boy with a flat nose, a bowl-cut of dark hair, and an aggressive, lumbering gait.
hp_descriptions.William Arthur Weasley: A tall, handsome, long-haired wizard who wears a fang earring and dragon-hide boots, looking ruggedly "cool" (later heavily scarred by Fenrir Greyback).
hp_descriptions.Winky: A tiny female house-elf with enormous brown eyes and a nose like a tomato, often found crying into a dirty tea towel.
hp_descriptions.Xenophilius Lovegood: An eccentric man with shoulder-length, fluffy white hair, looking slightly cross-eyed, and wearing brightly colored, bizarre robes.
hp_descriptions.Zacharias Smith: A haughty, aggressively arrogant boy with blonde hair and an upturned nose, constantly looking down on others.

hp_locations.Hogwarts: A massive, ancient, and breathtaking Scottish fortress perched on a cliff above a vast lake, teeming with high towers, turrets, moving staircases, and hidden passageways.
hp_locations.The Burrow: A chaotic, architectural marvel of a multi-story home, visibly held up by magic, sporting red roofs, cluttered chimneys, and an overwhelming atmosphere of warmth and homeliness.
hp_locations.Diagon Alley: A hidden, bustling, cobblestone shopping street in London, packed tight with bizarre and magical shopfronts selling everything from glowing cauldrons to shrieking toads.
hp_locations.Twelve Grimmauld Place: A dismal, magically hidden London townhouse that looks neglected and decaying, filled with dark wood, dusty velvet curtains, and the gloomy, oppressive history of the Black family.
hp_locations.The Ministry of Magic: A sprawling, subterranean complex beneath London lined with dark wood and magical tiles, centered around a massive Atrium featuring glowing fireplaces and golden statues.
hp_locations.Hogsmeade: A picturesque, entirely magical village of thatched cottages and bustling shops like Honeydukes and The Three Broomsticks, completely snow-covered in the winter.
hp_locations.Azkaban: A towering, pitch-black triangular fortress set on a tiny island in the middle of a freezing, turbulent sea, radiating misery and despair from the Dementors guarding it.
hp_locations.Malfoy Manor: An elegant but chilling aristocratic estate featuring high wrought-iron gates, perfectly manicured grounds with albino peacocks, and dark, echoing, grandiose interiors.
hp_locations.Number Four, Privet Drive: A perfectly ordinary, completely indistinguishable, and aggressively mundane suburban house in Little Whinging, impeccably clean and utterly devoid of magic.
hp_locations.Godric's Hollow: A quaint, historical West Country village featuring a cozy square, a memorial statue disguised to Muggles, and the overgrown, ruined cottage where the Potters once lived.
